flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui src/App.tsx, src/i18n/en/translation.json, src/utils/validation/Format/ValidFile.ts, src/utils/models/Icourtcase.d.ts, src/pages/NoticeSearch/{form/NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx,hook/useSearch.ts,hook/useSearchParams.tsx,list/NoticeSearchAllList.tsx}, src/pages/Notice/{context/NoticeContext.tsx,form/History.tsx}, src/pages/Report/{index.tsx,action/ActionReport.tsx}, src/utils/config/env.ts. ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsCourtCase/OcmsCourtCase.java (3 columns) and workflows/cas_integration/CasIntegrationController (inbound CAS, not credited). ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no court document upload code
note: The court document upload epic has no code in the six repos. Only leftovers exist in ocmsadminui: the label 'Court Upload Documents' in translation.json:105-106, the file rule court_upload_doc (10 MB, Document) in ValidFile.ts:182-185 which no component uses, the Icourtcase type (doc_type, file_name, b_lob, send_to_sc_flag) in Icourtcase.d.ts:41-49 with no upload user in the UI, and an empty '{/* COURT */}' block in App.tsx:313. The OcmsCourtCase entity in ocmsadminapi has only 3 columns (notice_no, court_payment_due_date, reason; OcmsCourtCase.java:20-31) and is used by the inbound CAS endpoints (CasIntegrationController), not for document upload; the CAS endpoints are not credited because no step of this story matches them. State Courts SFTP/batch is not in the six repos (earlier court epic finding). The status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)' is a sheet claim; the code does not support it. The general notice search in Notice Search can be reused, but there is no court flow around it and it is not tied to a court case type. The summons search is only a UI stub: it is called only when isAPIFound (STAGING or LOCAL), so it is off in production, and there is no summon controller in the six repos. The details shown are general notice details, not court details. No maintenance ticket changes this step.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. Only the general notice search exists and it is not part of a court upload flow; the summons search is not active in production.

steps.detail: The general Notice Search form has a notice_no field (NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx:64) and the hook reads it at useSearchParams.tsx:167. This is an ordinary staff search, not part of a court document upload flow, and not tied to the chosen court case type. Sebagian because the search-by-notice function exists but is not what the story names.

The UI has a summon_no field (NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx:438) and getNoticesBySummon calls GET 'summon' (useSearch.ts:56-66), but it is called only when isAPIFound (useSearchParams.tsx:208), and isAPIFound = isSTAGING || isLocal (env.ts:11), so it is off in production. In the backend there is no summon controller or entity in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, thirdpartyapi (grep summon, courtmention, courttrial, warrantofarrest: only in api-authorization.properties:23, no @RequestMapping). UI stub only; cannot verify from repo whether the backend exists in another system.

steps.step: Details related to the searched number are displayed
steps.detail: The notice search result shows a list of notices with general columns, including a court_date column (NoticeSearchAllList.tsx:170). There is no display of court case/mention/warrant details: OcmsCourtCase in ocmsadminapi has only notice_no, court_payment_due_date, reason (OcmsCourtCase.java:20-31) and the courtmention/courttrial/warrantofarrest endpoints the UI calls have no backend. Sebagian: general notice details show, court details do not.
